homeSections.stepsTitle: How to Convert Video to MP3 Online in 3 Steps
homeSections.step1Body: Pick an MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, or AVI file from your device. Everything stays locally in browser memory — nothing is ever uploaded to a server.
homeSections.step2Body: Drag the start and end waveform handles to keep only the exact clip you want, preview playback, and choose 320 kbps MP3, 192 kbps, 128 kbps, or lossless WAV.
homeSections.step3Body: Click Convert & Download. A dedicated Web Worker encodes your MP3 or WAV locally at full speed and saves it directly to your device.
homeSections.featuresTitle: Why Extract Audio in Your Browser?
homeSections.feature1Body: Most online converters force you to upload huge video files, wait in server queues, and risk your privacy. This converter decodes MP4, MOV, WebM, and OGG tracks directly via the Web Audio API in milliseconds.
homeSections.feature2Title: Supports MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV & AVI
homeSections.feature2Body: Native hardware-accelerated browser decoding handles everyday MP4, MOV, and WebM clips immediately, while a lightweight single-threaded WebAssembly decoder loads on demand only when an MKV or AVI file needs it.
homeSections.feature3Body: Inspect the full audio waveform, drag the start and end trim markers or enter exact timestamps, add smooth fade-in/fade-out edges, and export clean MP3 or 16-bit PCM WAV files.
homeSections.faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions About Video to MP3 Conversion
homeSections.faq1Q: Is this video to MP3 converter really private with zero uploads?
homeSections.faq1A: Yes. All audio extraction, waveform rendering, trimming, and MP3/WAV encoding happen 100% locally inside your browser using Web Audio API, Web Workers, and optional on-demand WebAssembly. Your video never leaves your device.
homeSections.faq2Q: Which video formats can I convert to MP3 or WAV?
homeSections.faq2A: You can extract audio from MP4, MOV, WebM, OGG, MKV, and AVI videos. MP4, MOV, WebM, and OGG decode instantly via your browser's native audio engine, while MKV and AVI automatically use a lazy WebAssembly fallback when needed.
homeSections.faq3Q: What MP3 bitrate should I choose: 128, 192, or 320 kbps?
homeSections.faq3A: Choose 320 kbps MP3 for studio-grade music and maximum fidelity, 192 kbps for a balanced file size on podcasts or lectures, 128 kbps for lightweight voice memos, or WAV for completely uncompressed 16-bit PCM audio.
homeSections.faq4Q: Is there any file size limit or daily conversion cap?
homeSections.faq4A: There are no artificial server limits, sign-ups, or daily caps because conversion runs on your own device's CPU and memory. Even multi-hundred-megabyte lecture or podcast videos convert smoothly.
homeSections.faq5Q: Can I trim only part of a video before saving the MP3?
homeSections.faq5A: Yes. Once a video loads, drag the Start and End handles directly on the interactive waveform or enter exact MM:SS.d timestamps, preview the selection, and export just the segment you need.

howToUse.title: How to Use Video to MP3 Converter
howToUse.subtitle: A quick guide to extracting studio-quality MP3 and lossless WAV audio from any video without uploading files.
howToUse.step1Title: Select or Drag Your Video File
howToUse.step1Body: Open the converter on the home page and drop an MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, or AVI file into the focal workspace box. Native formats load in milliseconds via AudioContext.decodeAudioData; MKV or AVI files load the lightweight WASM decoder automatically if needed.
howToUse.step2Title: Trim Start & End on the Interactive Waveform
howToUse.step2Body: Use the draggable Start and End markers—or type precise timestamps into the MM:SS.d inputs—to isolate a chorus, interview answer, or lecture segment. Press Play to verify your clip and optionally enable Smooth Fade.
howToUse.step3Title: Pick MP3 Bitrate (128 / 192 / 320 kbps) or Lossless WAV
howToUse.step3Body: Select 320 kbps for music, 192 kbps for balanced podcasts, 128 kbps for speech, or WAV for editing-ready 16-bit PCM audio. Click Convert & Download to encode in a background Web Worker and save your audio.
